accuracyFlags: Day 14 says 'returns north to Queenstown' after Day 13 in the Catlins and Day 11 already in Queenstown; route as written loops Queenstown twice and the Auckland-to-Queenstown framing is inconsistent.
Final paragraph advises avoiding 'driving the Lindis at dawn' before a Queenstown flight: the Lindis Pass is on the Wānaka to Omarama road and is not on the Catlins to Queenstown route.
Says freedom camping on Taupō's eastern shore is available 'for certified vehicles': unverified against Taupō District bylaw and DOC notices; cite or remove.
Day 6 Napier to Wellington and Day 7 ferry plus Queen Charlotte Drive is compressed; no drive times quoted despite the 'three to four hours' claim.
